info.title: Golden Raccoon HTTP API
info.summary: Token risk-scanning, portfolio, discovery, alerting, and transaction-execution API for the Golden Raccoon Next.js app.
info.description:
Versioned OpenAPI contract for every public HTTP route under `frontend/src/app/api/**`. See `docs/openapi/COMPATIBILITY.md` for the versioning/deprecation policy and `docs/openapi/ROUTE_COVERAGE.md` for the route-to-operationId-to-test mapping.

Authentication: most wallet-scoped routes derive the authoritative wallet from a signed, httpOnly `gr_wallet` session cookie (see `WalletSessionCookieAuth`). A `walletAddress` request field/query param may also be supplied, but it is validated against the session and rejected on mismatch; it never overrides the cookie. Routes that only accept a bare `walletAddress` value with no session enforcement are documented as unauthenticated.

All examples use synthetic placeholder addresses, hashes, and tokens. No real user data or secrets are included.

servers.description: Same-origin Next.js API routes (relative to the deployed frontend origin).

WalletSessionCookieAuth.name: gr_wallet
WalletSessionCookieAuth.description: Signed, httpOnly wallet-session cookie issued by `POST /wallet-session` after a successful `POST /wallet-session/nonce` challenge/response. Routes documented with this scheme resolve the authoritative wallet address from this cookie; a `walletAddress` body/query field is accepted for transparency but must match the cookie or the route responds 401/403.

WalletAddressQuery.name: walletAddress
WalletAddressQuery.description: Wallet address, informational only on session-scoped routes (the session cookie is authoritative). Required on routes with no session enforcement.

Error.description: Stable error contract. Routes migrated to `frontend/src/server/api/errors.ts` return exactly this shape (optionally with extra legacy fields kept for backward compatibility). Not-yet-migrated routes return `LegacyErrorEnvelope` instead; see COMPATIBILITY.md.

message.description: Human-readable summary safe to display or log.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same request may succeed without changes.

requestId.description: Opaque id for correlating this error with server logs.

details.description: Optional machine-readable extra context (e.g. field validation errors).

ValidationErrorDetails.description: Zod `.flatten()` shape used across all input-validated routes.

LegacyErrorEnvelope.description: Ad hoc error shape used by not-yet-migrated routes. `error` is either a short machine-readable string or a `ValidationErrorDetails` object; `detail` is an optional human-readable string.

MigratedErrorEnvelope.description: Response shape for routes migrated to the stable error contract while preserving their pre-existing `error`/`detail` fields for backward compatibility (see COMPATIBILITY.md, dual-shape policy).

ChainIdentity.description: Discriminated wallet/account identity: either an EVM address or a Stellar G-address, never both.

GenericObject.description: Loosely-typed object. Used for large internal result shapes (portfolio snapshots, decision raw signals, transaction records, discovery scan payloads) whose full shape is defined in TypeScript but not yet exhaustively modeled here.

AgentResult.description: Runtime-validated result contract shared by every specialist agent and the decision agent (`frontend/src/server/agents/schema.ts`).

TransactionRecord.description: Persisted transaction lifecycle record. Additional provider/chain-specific fields (e.g. `stellarDetails`) may be present.

MigratedValidationError400.description: Request body/query failed schema validation. Response includes both the stable error contract and the legacy `error` field.

query: String must contain at least 1 character(s)
String must contain at least 1 character(s)

Unauthorized401.description: No valid wallet session cookie present.

Forbidden403.description: The session wallet does not own the requested resource, or the supplied wallet does not match the session.

NotFound404.description: Resource not found (or not visible to the caller's wallet).

Conflict409.description: The request conflicts with current state (e.g. duplicate payment signature, already-recovered alert).

RateLimited429.description: Too many requests for this route's rate-limit namespace.

ProviderError502.description: An upstream provider (RPC, Stellar Horizon/RPC, market data, etc.) failed or timed out.

ServiceUnavailable503.description: The route is intentionally disabled by configuration (e.g. wallet-session cookie signing not configured).

PaymentRequired402.description: x402 payment required or the supplied payment could not be verified. Standard x402 response with `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`/`accepts` payment requirements; on retry with a valid `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header the request proceeds.
